hint.feature_title: Freeze Hint Prefer Newest Staged v1
hint.box_type: Intake / Contract / Freeze Hint Selection Order
do_not_regress_rules: New Local Freeze Entry must prefer the newest unused staged KANDA_FREEZE_HINT.json over older validated latest hints.
Already-frozen or used freeze hints must not reopen as the next local freeze draft.
Validation evidence must be preserved when rescanning the same staged hint/source.
The safe starter fallback must remain available when no current usable freeze hint exists.
KANDA_FREEZE_HINT.json must remain patch ZIP root delivery metadata and must not be installed into the active project root.
Freeze hint intake state must remain under the selected active project root at project_freeze_after_update/freeze_hint_intake.
Project-specific frozen memory must remain under project_freeze_after_update/frozen_features_memory.
Do not store project-specific frozen memory inside project_freeze_ledger.
hint.validation_evidence_summary:

STATUS: FREEZE_HINT_PREFER_NEWEST_STAGED_ACTIVE
hint.known_warnings: This formulary data is a project-local freeze hint for the validated selection-order repair. Human review is still required before Confirm and Write.
hint.planned_next_step: Open Freeze Feature After Update > New Local Freeze Entry, review the auto-filled fields, then Preview and Confirm and Write only after human approval.
hint.notes: Corrects freeze hint selection order so newer unused staged hints can become the current local freeze draft instead of an older validated latest hint staying active forever.
